title: ModelCheckOutcome
description: `POST /engines/claude/diagnostics/model-check`: one turn with a fixed minimal prompt, no tools, one turn, a spending ceiling — the only thing this plan does that spends quota, and only on a click (plan 13, B-12, D-08). The same shape `GET /engines/claude/installation`'s `lastModelCheck` carries, named again rather than declared twice (plan 28, B-48).
